# Draft:List of IFL awards

In the Indoor Football League (IFL), the highest level of professional indoor American football in North America, there are a variety of awards presented to recognize players and teams for outstanding achievements.
Team awards
IFL National Championship Trophy
Eastern Conference Championship Trophy
Western Conference Championship Trophy
Franchise of the Year
Fan Base Champions
Best Game Operations
Best Cheer / Dance Team
Best Community Relations
Best Hospitality
Best Social Media
Best Mascot
Best Game Day Broadcast
Individual awards
Most Valuable Player
The Most Valuable Player (MVP) award is handed out each year to the player adjudged to be the most valuable in the IFL that season. The first award was given to Chris Dixion in 2009. Dixon and Drew Powell are tied for the most awards with three wins each.
